content.short: Unichain is a DeFi focused Ethereum Layer 2 from Uniswap, built on the OP Stack with 200ms sub-blocks.
content.description: Unichain is an Ethereum Layer 2 developed by Uniswap Labs on the OP Stack and part of the Optimism Superchain. It is tuned specifically for onchain markets, not general purpose usage: sub-blocks land every 200 milliseconds so quotes update far faster than on a typical rollup, and block building runs inside a trusted execution environment to make ordering verifiable and limit extractable value taken from traders. Because it is a Superchain member, assets and messages move natively between Unichain and other OP Stack networks.
content.meta: Unichain is Uniswap's DeFi focused Ethereum Layer 2 with 200ms sub-blocks and verifiable block building. Discover it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
